title: agent-message
description: One message between agents. The payload holds ids and *_ref pointers only; the words live in a private file a *_ref names.

subject.description: msg. then 1 to 15 dotted tokens, NATS-safe: no *, no >, no empty token.

payload.description: Keys ending in _id hold an id, keys ending in _ref a ref. Any other key is refused, so no field can carry free text.

ref.description: A file under the private refs folder: 1 to 4 parts joined by /, each part dot-separated tokens, ending in .md, .json or .txt. No .., no leading /, no space.

utc.description: ISO-8601 in UTC, Z only, optional fraction.
